note: UPSC CMS 2026 Paper 1 and Paper 2, question booklet Series C. Stems, options and the printed answer of each question, from the Salaah Shots solution PDFs: an unofficial key (UPSC had not published its key), imported as a secondary-source signal (key_audit.SourceKey). Their explanations are not included (their own writing). Subjects: Paper 1 Paediatrics when the solution's chapter label names a paediatric field or immunisation, else General Medicine; Paper 2 by Series C block (1-40 PSM, 41-80 OBG, 81-120 Surgery). Match-the-list tables: Paper 1 Q24, Q113, Q115 read from the rendered pages; Paper 2 Q64, Q68 from the PDF table cells. Figures: the solution has none; its bracketed descriptions of them (their writing, often naming the answer) were removed, and the questions whose stem says a figure is shown (needs_figure) are imported hidden until an admin adds the figure from the official paper.

questions.subtopic: IMNCI Classification of Malnutrition and Anemia
questions.question_text: A 2-year-old child is brought with complaints of not growing well. On examination, he weighs 8.1 kg, height 80 cm (WFL score between 0 and -2 SD), has a mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) of 11.5 cm and both his palms are white. There is no edema of the feet. As per IMNCI, he will be classified as:
questions.option_b: No acute malnutrition and severe anemia
questions.option_d: Moderate acute malnutrition and severe anemia

questions.question_text: A 2-year-old previously unimmunized girl is brought with poor feeding and fever for 6 days. On day 4 of fever, her mother noticed a maculopapular reddish rash starting from the face and spreading over the neck, chest, arms and trunk over the next one day and she has developed extensive mouth ulcers. The child has a mid-arm circumference of 11 cm but no edema. As per IMNCI, she will be classified as:
questions.option_a: Measles with eye or mouth complications

questions.question_text: A term neonate weighing 2 kg, delivered to a primigravida mother through vaginal route and through clear liquor, is found having gasping respiratory efforts after performing the initial steps in the delivery room. The next step in resuscitation is:
questions.option_a: Initiate positive pressure ventilation with bag and mask using 30% oxygen
questions.option_b: Intubate and initiate positive pressure ventilation using 30% oxygen
questions.option_c: Initiate positive pressure ventilation with bag and mask using room air
questions.option_d: Intubate and initiate positive pressure ventilation using room air

On examination, RR is 36/m, HR is 110/m, CRT is < 3s, and there is abdominal distention. Abdominal radiograph reveals multiple air-fluid levels with absent distal gas pattern. 2. The disorder responds to antidepressant drugs.
3. Patients may be subjected to cognitive behaviour therapy.

Consider the following statements with regard to point mutations:

Consider the following statements regarding gas gangrene:
1. It is caused by clostridial species, e.g., Clostridium perfringens.
